question:
**Select the most appropriate option to complete the given sentence.**

The news of his arrest spread rapidly in every ______ of the city
solution:
The correct answer is: **nook and corner.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given phrases in the options section.
 
 
• **Rack and Ruin**: Become less successful; start to be in bad condition. (कम सफल हो; बुरी स्थिति में होने लगते हैं)

 
 
• **For example- ***After the founder's death the business went to rack and ruin.*
 
 
 
• **Ins and Outs**: The detailed or complicated facts of something. (किसी चीज का विस्तृत या जटिल तथ्य)
 
 
• **For example- ***I know how to use computers, but I don't really understand the ins and outs of how they work.*
 
 
 
• **Nook and Corner**: Every part of a place. (किसी स्थान का प्रत्येक भाग)
 
 
• **For example- ***I've searched for the book in every nook and corner of the library, but still can't find it.*
 
 
 
• **Life and Soul**: The lively and very energetic person at social events.
 
 
• **For example- ***Jonathan was talking to everyone and telling funny jokes. He was the life and soul of the party.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​*The sentence is talking about a piece of news that has rapidly spread.​
 
• So, according to the meaning of the given phrases "**nook and corner**" is the appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: *The word of his detention quickly travelled to each and every corner of the city.*
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3** which can complete the given sentence.

**Complete sentence:** *The news of his arrest spread rapidly in every nook and corner__ of the city.*
